:''The following discussion is preserved as an archive of a [[Wookieepedia:Requests for user rights#Requests for {{{1|adminship}}}|request for {{{1|adminship}}}]] that was '''{{{2|successful}}}'''. <span style="color:red">'''Please do not modify it.'''</span>''<noinclude></div>

==Usage==
This template should be placed at the top of an archived [[Wookieepedia:Requests for user rights|request for user rights]] page. To use this template, copy and paste <code><nowiki>{{subst:RFUR archive|</nowiki>{{Var|position}}|{{Var|outcome}}}}</code> onto the top of the page.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|position}}}} The specific user rights level for which the user was nominated: either <code>rollback</code>, <code>adminship</code>, <code>Discussions Moderator</code>, <code>Social Media Team membership</code>, <code>CheckUser</code>, or <code>bureaucratship</code>.
#{{Para||{{Var|outcome}}}} Either <code>successful</code> (in which case the parameter can be left blank) or <code>unsuccessful</code>.

Finally, add a <code><nowiki></div></nowiki></code> tag at the very end of the page.
